fusions.name: Pinned Mid-Paddle
fusions.desc: Flicks a pinfeather that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 50% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Moulting Shake
fusions.desc: Shakes off water and pinfeathers, dealing 4 water damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Preened Clean
fusions.desc: Removes 3 conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Flustered
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%, and your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
